title: Binding
description: A derived document that claims to be bound to a subject-record by content hash. Any consumer, copy, or reference that needs to prove it reflects a specific, unmutated subject-record uses this shape. See ../README.md.

kind.description: Domain-defined label for what this binding represents (e.g. "view", "copy", "reference").

bound_hash.description: Must equal the current content_hash of the subject-record this binds to. Checked by the validator, not by this schema alone.

attributes.description: Optional. Domain-defined fields for this binding.

composed_of.description: Optional. Present only when this binding reflects more than one subject-record.
